seedCompetitions: An admin needs to seed the 3 permanent competitions first.
regionalLeaguesDesc: Compete in your country's league. Top finishers earn a qualification spot.
stageChallengerDesc: Challengers prove themselves. Top clubs promote to Elite League.
supremeLeagueDesc: The best Elite League clubs earn the right to compete at the highest level.
tournamentsSubtitle: Compete, win, and claim your trophy
rankingsSubtitle: Official rankings based on STAGE competitions, leagues, and tournaments. Arrange Game results are excluded.
noRankedClubs: No clubs have official ranking data yet.
noRankedPlayers: No players have official ranking data yet.
registrationSubtitle: Register your club for a STAGE Regional League. Spots are limited - apply early.
needClub: You need a club to register for a league. Create one first from the {clubs} page.
noOpenRegistrations: No league registrations are currently open
checkBackRegistration: Check back when a season is in Registration status.
adminAssignsDivision: Admin will assign you to a division after reviewing your application.
registrationStep1: Submit your application for a region before registration closes.
registrationStep2: State your preferred division (1 or 2) - admin will consider it based on availability and club history.
registrationStep3: Admin reviews and assigns you to a division. You'll see your status update here.
registrationStep4: Once approved, your club appears in the league standings automatically.
registrationStep5: Registration closes when the season goes Active. Late applications are not accepted.
placementPreference: This is a preference - final placement is decided by the admin.
adminContextPlaceholder: Any context for the admin - club history, previous season results, etc.
